scientific_integrity: No independent verification, authorship, publication, or external certification is claimed. Exact symbolic certificates and reproducible numeric checks are provided.
scientific_limitations: The optimum concerns the positive relative weight of the two prescribed Fourier-root measurement channels and the linear lifted condition number on the identifiable subspace. The projector metric lower bound is certified but not proved sharp. Qualitative injectivity follows existing work.
title: Exact optimal weighting for an eight-sample quadratic Hermite Fourier phase-retrieval frame
